question: What is Diginex

beat.line: Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project and Resulticks were folded into the company.
beat.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beat.action: The screen flattens as four cutout building shapes slide in from the corners and interlock.

sources: Following acquisitions of Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, and the transformative addition of Resulticks, Diginex is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform spanning carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency, human rights due diligence, and now AI-driven customer data capabilities — designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
Diginex has now absorbed four distinct businesses (Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks) across multiple jurisdictions — a complex undertaking.

prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: pale cyan. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: four paper building shapes; the paper screen.
Opens on the paper screen, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The screen flattens as four cutout building shapes slide in from the corners and interlock.
Ends holding on the four-block bloc.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 ACQUISITIONS".

COPY LIST: "4 ACQUISITIONS". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project and Resulticks were folded into the company.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with refined 2D motion design. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, which immediately transitions to a flat, matte pale cyan background. The central element from the previous shot—a paper screen—quickly flattens and slides away as the action begins. Four distinct building shapes, rendered as black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges, slide rapidly into the frame from the four corners. These building cutouts possess a subtle paper texture with visible print dots and cast small, consistent shadows to the bottom-right, indicating a light source from the upper-left. As they reach the center, they interlock precisely to form a stable four-block cluster. Simultaneously, a large, extra-bold black sans-serif headline "4 ACQUISITIONS" appears, printed on a clean white paper chip with a torn edge, positioned with generous margins. The motion is snappy with a slight overshoot before landing in a stable position. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project and Resulticks were folded into the company.</d> The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5 seconds, ending on a hold of the final composition with a very subtle, rhythmic floating loop of the paper elements.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the crisp, tactile sounds of paper manipulation. Distinct, light paper-slap sounds occur as each building cutout slides and interlocks, accompanied by the short, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down.
